cj_batch_list_and_export.description: Batch select up to 200 items per page in CJ List view, add to 'My Products', and bulk export thousands of items to CSV/Excel.
steps: 1. Click the 'List' icon toggle in top right (next to 'Grid').
2. Click the 'Select All' checkbox in the dark table header bar to check all 60-200 items on the page.
3. Click the orange 'Selected Items: X/200' button in the upper right.
4. In the resulting batch modal, check 'All Products' at the bottom and click 'Add To My Products' or 'Export'.
